from cache import make_key
from service import score

def test_caching():
    # store as dict
    store = {}
    def compute():
        return 42
    
    # first call
    res1 = score(store, 'job1', 'profile1', 'criteria1', compute)
    assert res1 == 42
    # key in store
    assert len(store) == 1
    
    # reuse same inputs
    res2 = score(store, 'job1', 'profile1', 'criteria1', compute)
    assert res2 == 42
    # store should still have one entry (no recomputation)
    assert len(store) == 1
    
    # change job_text only
    res3 = score(store, 'job2', 'profile1', 'criteria1', compute)
    assert res3 == 84  # new compute
    # store should have two entries
    assert len(store) == 2
    
    # change profile only
    res4 = score(store, 'job1', 'profile2', 'criteria1', compute)
    assert res4 == 126  # new compute
    assert len(store) == 3
    
    # change criteria only
    res5 = score(store, 'job1', 'profile1', 'criteria2', compute)
    assert res5 == 168  # new compute
    assert len(store) == 4
    
    # change two inputs
    res6 = score(store, 'job2', 'profile2', 'criteria1', compute)
    assert res6 == 210  # new compute
    assert len(store) == 5
    
    # None values: job_text=None, profile_version=None, criteria_version=None
    # unchanged None should reuse if all None
    store2 = {}
    res7 = score(store2, None, None, None, lambda: 1)
    assert res7 == 1
    assert len(store2) == 1
    res8 = score(store2, None, None, None, lambda: 2)  # same inputs
    assert res8 == 1  # reuse
    assert len(store2) == 1
    # change profile only from None
    res9 = score(store2, None, 'profile1', None, lambda: 3)
    assert res9 == 3  # new compute
    assert len(store2) == 2

def test_make_key():
    key = make_key('t', 'p', 'c')
    # tuple
    assert key == ('t', 'p', 'c')
    # ensure all three affect caching: keys differ when any differs
    assert make_key('t1', 'p', 'c') != key
    assert make_key('t', 'p1', 'c') != key
    assert make_key('t', 'p', 'c1') != key
    # None values ok
    key_none = make_key(None, None, None)
    key_none2 = make_key(None, None, None)
    assert key_none == key_none2
    key_none_diff = make_key(None, None, 'c')
    assert key_none_diff != key_none

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_make_key()
    test_caching()
    print('All tests passed')
